manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the gold text on playing cards box in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips and move it.

Task description: The target is the black playing-card box with gold lettering on the left of the table; the container is the central yellow rectangular basket with two black handles. Put the box inside and lift and move it together with the basket.

Success criteria: The card box must be inside, near and in actual contact with the basket body, with no table contact. Both basket and card box must be clearly higher than their initial positions, with the basket opening upward and no excessive tilt. Loading a basket still on the table or sliding it along the table does not count.

## Execution tips

- The card box is thin. Consider gripping middle sections of opposite edges with an opening slightly greater than the grasp width and pads on the sidewalls. Confirm the fingers straddle it before closing rather than pressing its face or the table.
- The black handle obscures part of the basket opening. Lower the card box through an unobstructed part of the opening and leave clearance between the box and fingertips and the handle and rim to avoid catching.
- Before releasing the card box, let its bottom rest on the basket's support surface. Open only enough to clear the box, avoiding an unsupported drop or spreading the fingertips against the basket wall.
- When grasping the handle, choose a straight crossbar section away from its end attachments that both fingers can surround. Match the opening to bar thickness, avoiding attachment points or both fingers falling on the same side.
- When lifting the basket, apply force smoothly. If both hands hold it, lift both sides in sync to reduce tilting and sudden turns that could slide the card box toward or out of the rim.
